verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa and green-card services, not a software or data-hosting product. A user-selectable data storage region or residency setting is a category error for this kind of business, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
